title: chat-types: ChatContact gains identity
description: ChatContact.id is a server-assigned local RFC 8620 Id; new immutable server-set ChatContact.identity (String) holds the authentication-layer identity. Update types, docs, examples, fixtures that use URI/user@host strings as ids (e.g. did:web:alice.example, user:alice@example.com).
notes:
Implemented (uncommitted): ChatContact.identity: String (required), ChatContact::new gains identity param, ChatContactProperty::Identity, id/Mention.id rustdoc rewritten as local Id, server ChatContact/set rejects identity in update (invalidProperties) + test contact_set_update_identity_rejected. Fixtures updated: server MemoryBackend contacts set identity; client/types fixtures use local Ids (c1/c2) instead of user@host; push.rs example senderId -> c8xq2m per push draft cefc217. All gates green.
Done in 792f4f35: tests identity_is_a_typed_property, identity_is_required; changed existing tests: contact::tests::contact_deser_minimal, contact::tests::chat_contact_preserves_vendor_extras, contact::tests::contact_blocked_present, contact::tests::contact_did_uri_id_round_trips_verbatim -> renamed contact_did_uri_identity_round_trips_verbatim, push::tests::push_deser_spec_example, mention_is_id_only, chat_contact_get_decodes_populated_contact, chat_contact_changes_passthrough_and_empty_state_rejected, chat_contact_update_blocked_patch_serialises, chat_contact_update_display_name_clear_emits_null, Message create-with-mentions test (mention_json at ~line 1401) and message_update_mentions_emits_wire_key, contact_blocked_null_resets_to_false, contact_blocked_wrong_type_rejected_and_get_succeeds, plus 6 ChatContact fixtures in integration.rs (u1, blocked-user, allowed-user, 3x ct1)
